prompt.text: You step out to take a parcel. The work laptop is unlocked. Someone in the house sits down and says they only need it for a minute.

choices.label: Let them use it
choices.debrief: A minute on a work laptop is still a work session.
choices.report: Someone else used the unlocked work laptop.
choices.voice_line: You let someone else onto the work laptop.

fallout.text: A personal upload sits in the work history from the hour you were at the door.

choices.label: Lock it and take it with you
choices.debrief: Locked and in your hand is the whole control.
choices.bark: You locked it and took it.
choices.report: The laptop was locked before you left the room.
choices.voice_line: You locked the laptop and took it with you.

choices.label: Stay in the doorway and let them finish
choices.debrief: Watching is not the same as it being your session.
choices.report: Someone else worked on the laptop while you watched.
choices.voice_line: You watched someone else use the work laptop.

fallout.text: They saved a copy of a work file onto a personal stick while you were watching the parcel, not the screen.

draft_note: Home beat is physical custody of a remote machine, not a wifi question.
